description: This file defines a PHP trait 'InstallerRedirectTrait' that provides methods to check if Drupal is installed and whether to redirect to the installer based on exceptions and environment conditions.

methods.name: isCli
methods.description: Checks if the current PHP process is running on the command line interface (CLI).

methods.name: shouldRedirectToInstaller
methods.description: Determines if the exception handler should redirect to the Drupal installer based on the exception and database connection state.
